data.name: v0.28.0
data.body:
## What's Changed

- **DeepSeek-V4 / DSpark**: fix FlashMLA head padding with BF16 KV cache, keep DSpark `main_proj` in BF16, and sync the MLA base class. Keep main_proj in BF16 by @caozuoba in https://github.com/MetaX-MACA/vLLM-metax/pull/337
- **Platform and attention**: force-enable the sparse attention indexer and add the `check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer` platform interface.
- **Operators and MoE**: register OOT implementations for `SituAndMul` and `ReLUSquaredActivation`; sync Modular MoE and all-to-all; remove imports of an upstream-deleted Marlin MoE class.
- **Patch cleanup**: remove legacy Triton LoRA compatibility patches; retain version-specific telechat3-yarn adaptations.
- **Dependencies and tooling**: remove the previous `kv_connectors` dependency entries, update TVM FFI and numba, and refactor batch validation tools.
- **Upstream interface changes**: move bitsandbytes to an OOT plugin and remove `calculate_kv_scales` and `override_attention_dtype`.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MetaX-MACA/vLLM-metax/compare/v0.27.0...v0.28.0

data.name: v0.27.0
data.body:
- **DeepSeek-V4**: update model, sparse MLA, and speculative decoding interfaces; fix `_gather_k_cache_kernel` stride order and disable the model's FP8 KV cache layout by default.
- **MiniMax-M3**: fix Triton shared-memory limits; disable `cooperative_topk` / `persistent_topk`, which mcoplib does not support.
- **MoE**: fix mctlass FP8, skip invalid experts, and explicitly prohibit non-batched DeepGEMM for INT8 W8A8.
- **Distributed execution and memory**: add mxmesh support, fix MCCL all-gather hangs, and add `MacaMemBackend` for sleep mode.
- **Toolchain integration**: update csrc, custom operators, and attention backends; disable `cudaLaunchAttribute` on MACA.
